For `services/summarizer/`: it calls Claude through the Messages API, so type `/claude-api build-eval` to build its first eval suite. Two cautions there. Meeting notes often carry names and internal details, so use redacted or synthetic notes as inputs. And wait to reach for `/claude-api hillclimb` until that suite exists and gives you a baseline; hillclimb improves against a suite, it doesn't create one.

For the plugin with three skills: `claude plugin eval` runs its cases with the plugin and against a no-plugin baseline. Use `/evals:design` to scaffold the cases and `/evals:plugin-eval` to run them.

Two suites, each matched to what its part actually is.
